doc: E-ADAPT layer (doc 29). Only what the original data does not say: which original file the engine links to each trial move, unit scales and base numbers that come from tables we do not have. Every original value (ANI frames/boxes, ATK reaction fields, SKL MP/cool/level info, CHR/MOB stats) is read from the compiled content pack, never copied here.

player.source: physical_attack has no original equivalent until equipment/stats exist; walk/run px/s are the trial calibration for CHR move speed 850; weapon_index is the CHR weapon subtype row (E-INFER from sound names).

units.source: CHR/MOB move speed values are scaled by walk_speed/move_speed_reference to px/s. PTL move variables are already px/s (throw stone 250 px/s x 1200 ms = goblin sight 300).

reaction.source: Units of ATK push aside / lift up and of hit recovery are not documented by the data; these scales make attack3 (push 40, lift 300) launch about 50 px high.

hitstop.source: No ATK in scope carries [stuck]; per-reaction defaults.

monster_base.source: Monster level tables are absent; MOB [ability category] percentages multiply these bases.

buff.source: Frenzy level info columns are not decoded yet; trial effect values kept from the previous adaptation.

upper.name: 上挑
upper.source: Motion = CHR [etc motion] #2 hitback.ani (sm_body 51-59: low guard, rising swing, sword overhead); the oldest etc slots are guard / hardattack (鬼斩) / upper slash (E-INFER). upperslashafter.ani reuses the 裂波斩 vaneslashtry poses 199-203 and is not the 1-level skill. Effects upperslash1/2.ani line up with the swing at 150/200 ms; box = their pixel extent; UPPER_SLASH_01 = sounds/char/swordman/effect/upper_slash_01.ogg.

triple.name: 三段斩
triple.source: Slash bodies carry no attack boxes; boxes are the original slash effect extents. SKL static_data [600, -1000] read as slide start speed px/s and deceleration px/s² (E-INFER): each stage slides 180 px, easing to a stop at 600 ms.

rage_slash.name: 十字斩
rage_slash.source: Slash windows follow the body pose groups (frames 0-5, 6-9); the crescent object starts at frame 14 (GORECROSS_ATK3) on the caster's own anchor (composite of gorecross.ani + gorecross1.ani lines up without offset).

backstep.source: Down + jump. Original back step has no motion file of its own (CHR [back motion] points at attack3.ani); the jump.ani rise/fall poses are used (E-ADAPT). Only normal attacks can be cancelled for now (user 2026-10-23); a cancel leaves a fading afterimage of the cancelled pose (engine-drawn in the original, E-ADAPT).

rooms_source: Original lorien.dgn grid (2x3). Start (1,0) is a listed start candidate; boss (1,2) a listed boss cell; each step uses a door both neighbours own. Map per cell picked from its candidates (start/normal/boss role). Monster names are the CN client names typed in (the archive only has Korean strings), E-ADAPT.
